about: Stage 13 QA set for questions in natural language (decision 0024). 30 questions against the fixed seed corpus in testmail/corpus/seed (the files, not the generated filler). `query` is the search a good model should produce in the stage 7 language; `expect` lists the seed files that answer the question (empty: nothing in the corpus answers it, the app must say so). `answer` is the fact a correct answer states. The harness (crates/mail-engine/src/ai/qa_tests.rs) runs every question against the in-memory mail server: with the mock model it checks the pipeline and the local search with the reference query; with a real local model (VICE_MAIL_QA_BASE_URL, VICE_MAIL_QA_MODEL) it measures citations. No dates: the in-memory server dates its messages itself.
